description: Elendara wears a burgundy floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold geometric woven borders at the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, centre and hem. Round shoulder and belt brooches secure the layers. A dark navy fringed wrap with gold woven borders rests around her forearms, and ivory linen cuffs show beneath the sleeves. A pale ivory underdress is visible through the lower walking opening, with brown closed leather shoes below. Her loose chestnut side gathering is uncovered.
